notes: GPUI VIEW. The target UI framework is GPUI 0.2.2 (Zed's framework), not React. You have no training knowledge of this exact API, so read before writing: rever/src/main.rs (how elements, text styling and theme are used here), every file in rever-ui-kit/src, vendor/gpui/examples/*.rs (text.rs, text_layout.rs, text_wrapper.rs) and vendor/gpui/src/elements/*.rs and vendor/gpui/src/styled.rs for exact method names; for styled spans inside one paragraph look at gpui's StyledText / TextRun / InteractiveText in vendor/gpui/src/elements/text.rs. What to build: the React component renders chat messages with react-markdown plus remark-gfm; here, parse Markdown with the pulldown-cmark crate (enable tables, strikethrough and task lists) and build GPUI elements: paragraphs with inline bold, italic, strikethrough, inline code and links; headings h1 to h4; ordered and unordered lists including nesting and task items; fenced code blocks in a monospace font with horizontal scrolling; block quotes; tables; horizontal rules. Styling follows the `.chat-log .md` rules and the `.md` rules in src/renderer/src/styles.css (font sizes, margins, code background, table borders, quote border). Expose a function or component such as `markdown(text, &Theme) -> impl IntoElement`, cheap to call on every render while a message is streaming (incomplete Markdown must not panic and should render as far as it parses). Clicking a link emits or calls back with the URL; it must not open anything itself. Keep parsing-to-blocks logic in plain functions with Korean-named unit tests. Preview: fill examples/preview.rs so `cargo run -p rever-ui-markdown --example preview_markdown` shows a long sample with every construct (use rever_ui_kit::preview::run). Look at your own work: while it runs, `scripts/capture-window.sh preview_markdown /tmp/preview_markdown.png` captures only that window; read the PNG and fix what is off. Do not bring windows to the front, do not capture the screen any other way, and do not run the `rever` app. The first build of a GPUI crate takes a few minutes.
